rationale: The task introduces a new Codex default prompt and therefore changes canonical, user-visible workflow semantics in an existing AGDF repository. No approved and durable UR or completed Brownfield Review with an evidenced Mode/Slice Decision is provided, so AGDF must fail closed instead of selecting a delivery path.
decision_grounds: The canonical router requires gate-check first for a new change or capability and requires a durable UR for new product,
